verdict.rationale: Browser control is a fair axis for an AI agent product, but the evidence pack never shows AnythingLLM navigating, logging in, or clicking in a live browser. The 'Web Scraping & Search' label is an adjacent capability, not interactive browser driving. Custom agent skills and MCP compatibility are only developer building blocks for constructing such a capability, so none of these earns credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
